text:
Priya Nair: Quick async check — Kestrel renewal escalation. Short summary: customer hit a spike in embedding webhook retries after switching to our v2 client. What I did: verified their logs, reproduced locally with a sample payload, opened support ticket KST-421.

Priya Nair: Blockers: need eng help to confirm backpressure behavior on Dedicated pool 'ded-kestrel-us-west2' and a hotfix to reduce the retry storm.

Priya Nair: Today: pairing with Leo at 11:30 PT, prepping customer notes for the renewal call at 4pm PT.

Leo Kim: on it — will triage logs. Priya can you paste a sample request id and a minimal repro curl?

Priya Nair: sample req id: abc123. Minimal repro:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test payload","model":"embed-small-q4_0"}'
```

Jared Ortiz: I'm from eng-infra — I can add a temporary route-level rate cap. Which exact route is spiking? /v2/embeddings or a batch endpoint?

Priya Nair: single sync route /v2/embeddings. Customer is doing short bursts (lots of single-shot requests). Pool: ded-kestrel-us-west2; model q4_0.

Maya Singh: FYI renewal call at 4pm PT — we need a concise remediation note + timeline to share with the customer.

Leo Kim: understood. I'll inspect retry logic and prefix/cache behavior. Will avoid aggressive batching changes (customer wants lower latency). If we need a hotfix, ETA for a canary patch ~2–3 hours.

Jared Ortiz: give me thumbs to change prod routing for a soft cap. I can roll a 100 rps per-customer rule with a 5s burst.

Priya Nair: approved — go ahead Jared.

Jared Ortiz: pushed rule rl-873 (soft cap 100 rps, burst 5s). Monitoring now, will post metrics in ~10m.

cs-bot: Incident created KST-421 — severity: high. Assignees: Priya Nair, Leo Kim, Jared Ortiz.

Maya Singh: Priya please add the incident link to the renewal doc so sales has the context.

Priya Nair: added https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/KST-421 to the renewal notes.

Leo Kim: quick Q — customer model is q4_0, correct? I want to avoid per-model kernel changes that affect latency.

Priya Nair: yes q4_0. They explicitly asked for latency improvements, so keep batching conservative.

Leo Kim: good. I'll try a kernel tweak first and run a canary on ded-kestrel; will avoid large batching changes.

Jared Ortiz: metrics show 429 spikes and increased dropped tokens. Rolling back a recent traffic steering change at 15:02 reduced errors by ~20%.

Priya Nair: thanks — blocker partially mitigated. Rate cap should flatten remaining bursts; I'll update the renewal call notes.

Maya Singh: I'll draft a 3-bullet pre-call script: 1) what happened, 2) what we fixed (rate cap + canary), 3) next steps and timeline. Priya add the bullets please.

Priya Nair: done — short bullets added to the doc.

Leo Kim: once things stabilize I'll draft a short postmortem and tag this incident. If the canary fails, ping me immediately.

Jared Ortiz: deploying a CPU probe to ded-kestrel to detect backpressure. If anyone sees regressions, notify eng-infra.

Priya Nair: thanks all. If no objections I'll close this thread after the 4pm sync and move notes into the renewal deck. :thumbsup:

Maya Singh: +1

Leo Kim: :thumbsup:

Jared Ortiz: :thumbsup:
